description: The 'dss_retrieval_augmented_llms_live' dataset is designed to manage and track retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) within a data science platform. It includes metadata and configuration details for various LLM projects, allowing users to efficiently organize and access model information. Key features of this dataset include project identifiers, LLM versions, and associated knowledge base IDs, which are crucial for maintaining model lineage and version control. Additionally, the dataset captures URLs for accessing specific model instances, retrieval source types, and embedding configurations, which are essential for understanding the model's operational context. Timestamp fields for creation and modification provide insights into the model's lifecycle, while user information fields track who created or last modified the models. This dataset is particularly useful for data scientists and engineers who need to manage multiple LLM projects, ensuring that all relevant information is easily accessible and up-to-date. It supports efficient model deployment, monitoring, and auditing processes, making it a valuable resource for organizations leveraging LLMs in their operations.
shortDesc: Dataset for managing retrieval-augmented LLMs with metadata and configurations.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each LLM project.

columns.name: rag_llm_id
columns.comment: Unique ID for retrieval-augmented LLM instance.

columns.name: activeVersion
columns.comment: Current active version of the LLM.

columns.name: llmId
columns.comment: Identifier for the specific LLM used.

columns.name: kb_id
columns.comment: Knowledge base ID associated with the LLM.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL to access the LLM instance.

columns.name: retrievalColumns
columns.comment: Columns used for retrieval in JSON array.

columns.name: retrievalSource

columns.name: created_timestamp

columns.name: last_modified_user

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the LLM in JSON array.
